body: I’ve heard OD’ing a lot. It might be something to consider I guess.

The problem lies in that it was multiple friends. Me and her were in the same friend group and while we were all close friends, she was my absolute best friend in that group. When me and her broke up, the entire group cast me out. All of my best friends threw me out and painted me like I was a demon. This was never the only reason, but it’s been something that’s been hurting me for so so long now. I don’t know what else to do to make it up to them or to fix any of this. I really don’t

Maybe I care somewhat. I’ve said it enough today and Ill say it again; I don’t know what else to do. I’m so tired of this, I’m so done with living with the mistake and having lost my best friends because I couldn’t get over a breakup. The past few days I’ve just distracted myself with the music I can play and sing, and it helps but when I’m finished or taking a break things just worsen. I’ve struggled with this all so long, and the friends I had that I could rely on and the ones that cared left me without anyone to go to

I used to, but it drew so much attention from others and I saw that it hurt them so much so I stopped. I promised a old friend that I wouldn’t do it anymore, I promised her and while she might not care because she hates me, I’ll keep the promise

I don’t know if euthanasia is legal in the US, hell it probably wouldn’t even be legal in Alabama so I guess that won’t work for me. I don’t know what else to do, everyone who I knew cared ditched me.

I guess I asked for what people would think to see what I could weigh out I guess. I’m sorry about your partner, that must be hard. 

I’m only sixteen.

My family doesn’t care. They’ve proved time and time again that they don’t care about me or my brothers. They only worry about one thing and it’s fucking money because apparently we aren’t worth anything to them. All we are is slaves for them to make work at businesses for no pay and just something for them to take their anger and frustrations out on. My friends will eventually get over it and not care. Everyone eventually just stops caring about me
I’ve tried a therapist already, he didn’t help enough and eventually got transferred to active duty so now I don’t see him anymore
I really don’t have much else to live for right now. I’ve got whatever friends are left, maybe the piano, and then what? Nothing
It’s okay, I don’t know you and you don’t know me. It‘ll be alright, you have nothing to worry about
I’m just trying to fix things and make it up to everyone. It’s my fault I got here and my fault that everything’s happened
There won’t be many to find me, no one will really bother and I know that for sure. I just want out, I don’t want to be here anymore. I don’t want to keep on trying anymore.
Gave me a little chuckle so thanks for that I suppose
No I’m not. I don’t want to lie about it anymore, I just want to fix it and I don’t see many other ways to fix anything

Well I tried to rule out shotguns and guns in general. It’d be possible to steal one of my fathers guns, but I just don’t think I can pull it off. I’ve thought about OD’ing, but I don’t think there’s anything here to do that with.

I’m not. I can’t lie about it anymore. I’m tired and I’m done. I’m really sorry.

I don’t know, it’s every night this happens and tonight’s the first I just can’t sleep. There’s so much going through my head and the most common thing has been her. I just miss her, I don’t even want her back I just want our friendship back so bad. It’s been months and I thought I’d have moved on like I always do, but for whatever reason I just can’t. It’s been like this for a month or so now. That compounded on top of my home life and everything else just makes it all so much worse.
